description: Change a film's metadata (title, synopsis, director and cast lines, year, runtime, genres from the fixed list, country of production, what it was shot on (capture_format, camera), student_film, filming_locations, awards (checked by the Vidreno team before they show publicly), IMDb link, extra links, the AI disclosure mostly_ai_generated shown as 'Made with AI' on the film page, age_rating (all, 13, 16 or 18 — required to publish; 18+ titles ask viewers to confirm their age before playback) and content_descriptors (sexual content or nudity require age_rating 18), allow_search_engines: off keeps the page reachable by link but hides it from search engines and the sitemap, show_view_count: off keeps the film's view count off its public page and the profile cards), how it is released (access: free = Free to watch, which needs no price; paid = Buy or rent) and its buy/rent prices in US cents (minimum $1.00), or detach its trailer. Only the fields given are changed; the same validation as the film editor applies, and a published film whose publish checklist no longer passes returns to draft. The poster cannot be set here: it is added in the film editor (the edit link). The main film is replaced with start_film_upload, never detached.

access.description: How the film is released: free (Free to watch) or paid (Buy or rent; needs at least one price to publish).

age_rating.description: Age rating of the whole title (a series' rating covers every episode): all = All ages, 13 = 13+, 16 = 16+, 18 = 18+. An 18+ title asks viewers to confirm they're 18 or over before it plays. Sexual content or nudity makes a film 18+. Required to publish; once chosen it can be changed but not cleared.

allow_search_engines.description: "Allow search engines to discover this film" (on by default). Off keeps the page reachable by its link but hides it from search engines and the sitemap.

awards.description: Festival selections and prizes (festival, award, year); the list is replaced as a whole. Each entry is checked by the Vidreno team before it shows publicly: an unchanged entry keeps its verification, a new or edited one starts as pending.

buy_price.description: Buy price in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only used when access is paid.

camera.description: Camera make: red = RED, arri = ARRI, sony = Sony, canon = Canon, blackmagic = Blackmagic, panasonic = Panasonic, iphone = iPhone, other = Other; null clears it.

capture_format.description: What it was shot on: digital = Digital, 16mm = 16mm film, 35mm = 35mm film, super8 = Super 8, other-film = Other film stock; null clears it.

cast.description: Cast line, comma separated; null clears it.

comments_enabled.description: Whether viewers can comment on the film page.

content_descriptors.description: Content descriptors shown on the film page: sexual-content = Sexual content, nudity = Nudity, violence = Violence, strong-language = Strong language, drug-use = Drug use, disturbing = Horror / disturbing scenes. The list is replaced as a whole; an empty list clears it. Sexual content or nudity makes a film 18+. (age_rating must be 18 — the call is refused otherwise).

country.description: Country of production as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (GB, US, FR…); null clears it.

detach.description: Remove a file from the film: trailer deletes the current trailer. The main film cannot be detached, only replaced with start_film_upload.

director.description: Director line shown on the film page (credits are managed separately); null clears it.

extra_links.description: Extra links shown on the film page (label + URL, up to 20). Replaces the whole list; an empty list clears it.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

filming_locations.description: Where it was filmed, as free-text places ("Glasgow, Scotland"); up to 10, the list is replaced as a whole.

genres.description: Genres from the fixed list (action = Action, adventure = Adventure, animation = Animation, biography = Biography, comedy = Comedy, crime = Crime, documentary = Documentary, drama = Drama, experimental = Experimental, family = Family, fantasy = Fantasy, history = History, horror = Horror, music = Music, musical = Musical, mystery = Mystery, romance = Romance, sci-fi = Science fiction, sport = Sport, thriller = Thriller, war = War, western = Western); up to 4, the list is replaced as a whole. At least one is required to publish.

mostly_ai_generated.description: AI disclosure: true when "The majority of this film is AI-generated". Shown to viewers as 'Made with AI' on your film page.

rent_price.description: Rental price in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only used when access is paid.

rental_window_hours.description: How long a rental lasts, in hours.

runtime_minutes.description: Runtime in minutes; null clears it.

show_view_count.description: "Show view and favourite counts publicly" (on by default). Shows the film's views and favourites on its page and on your profile. Off keeps both numbers to you in Studio.

student_film.description: Made as a student film: Made while studying, as coursework or a graduation film.
